notes: BI-DB506554 UX fit: fits-with-guardrails. Owning area Run the platform (Admin > Contributing & GitHub, /admin/platform-development). Persona: non-technical operator ending a handed-over account's agent access. Layer: local page section only, no new route, tab or nav record; deep-linked by ?account=<email>#agent-access from plan_account_handover. Reuse: report-kit DataTable and Notice, form TextField, Dialog promptDialog (same pattern as the per-client People panel). Source truth: McpApiToken, OAuthRefreshToken, OAuthClient via lib/auth/account-agent-access.ts. Empty state: tables render only when non-empty; 'holds no live agent access' when nothing is live; an unknown account shows a plain error. One danger action with a required reason; none on the operator's own account. No AI/prompt send. The area page change only reads its tab labels from AREA_VIEW_LABELS (no visible change).
